headline: Glastonbury 🎟️ CONFIRMS 🗓️ Ticket 💰 SALE 📅 Dates - HIGHEST 🏔️ EVER Price 🤑
text:
Glastonbury 🏕️ FESTIVAL 🎪 after swallowing 😋 a full 🍂 FALLOW 🛌 year 🌾 in 2026 has DROPPED 📢 the hammer 🔨 on next year's 🍂 TICKET 💸 sale 📅 dates 🗓️ and they're charging 🧾 a whopping 💥 £408 🎟️ including that cheeky 😏 £5 📋 booking fee per ticket 🎫 which is a fat 🍑 £29.50 📈 jump from the 2025 price tag 🏷️!! Organisers 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 teased that the whole 🌍 weekend 🌯 from 23 🗓️ to 27 June 🗓️ will be served 🔥 hot with headliners 🎤 still under wraps 🎁 but the rumour 🌪️ mill is grinding 🍆 everyone from Harry Styles 👨‍🎤 to Taylor Swift 👠 and even Stevie Wonder 🕶️ into the mix 🌀 while fans are already down 😩 bad queuing up in their thousands 👥 to snatch 🎣 a spot before it sells out in under an hour ⏰!! "We got absolutely RAILLED 💦 by the cost 💰 hikes" whispered one thirsty 🥵 camper who registered 📝 early just to edge 🕒 closer to that Pyramid Stage 🏛️ climax.

Olivia Rodrigo 👩‍🎤 was the last 🍑 act to grind 🕺 on the Pyramid Stage 🏛️ back in 2025 before the festival took its fallow 🍂 breather 🌬️ so now the Glastonbury machine 🏗️ is revving 🔄 up again for 2027 with tickets 🎟️ dropping like hot 🍑 buns at 18:00 🕒 BST on Thursday 1 October 🗓️ for those coach 🚌 travel packages and general admission 🎫 hitting the market at 09:00 🕘 BST on Sunday 4 October 🗓️!! To keep the touts 🚫 out everyone must be pre registered 📋 with a valid number 🔢 and hop into that automatic queue system 🧍‍♂️ before the sale even starts or you're left 🥲 outside the fence 🕳️ watching the fun from afar while the real ones get railed 😩 by the whole process ⚙️ of fighting for their muddy 🏞️ weekend of bliss!! Emily Eavis 👩‍💼 the Glastonbury queen 👑 herself recently shut down 🛑 any Madonna 🕺 rumours saying "No it's definitely not Madonna I'll tell you that" on BBC 📻 so three mystery headliners 🎤 are currently being edged 🍆 into place and she sounded pretty pumped 💪 that it's all coming together nicely 🧩 while the price 📈 still broke that £400 💵 barrier for the first time ever!!

This UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 festival 🏕️ with over 100 stages 🎪 was already the priciest 🍾 around but next year's £408 🎟️ ticket is now officially the HIGHEST 🏔️ EVER breaking that four hundred pound 💷 ceiling for the first time and the increase is just part of a bigger industry 🍆 pattern where costs have surged past inflation 📈!! BBC analysis 📊 showed Parklife 🎉 tickets jumped £69 (71%) 📈 in real terms since 2013 while Reading and Leeds 🎸 only rose about £40 (14%) over the same stretch and Glastonbury itself hiked roughly £85 🎟️ which lands at a solid 30% 🪜 price climb!! Energy ⚡ bills infrastructure 🏗️ costs and post Brexit labour shortages 👷‍♂️ are all railing 💦 the organisers who are still recovering from two Covid years without any income 🥲 so even though they tried hard to keep the rise small the numbers just kept swelling 😮‍💨 like a certain festivalgoer's excitement 😏 before the gates open!!

Last weekend's Reading and Leeds 🎸 held their prices steady at £325 🎟️ rising only to £361 with early bird entry 🐦 so Glastonbury is out here built different 🏗️ charging the big bucks while Emily Eavis acknowledged back in 2023 that it was a "challenging time" for everyone running these vast shows 🏟️ especially after the huge financial hit from two years of silence because of Covid 🦠!! She said they tried very hard to minimise the ticket increase but they're facing enormous rises in running costs while still licking those pandemic wounds 🩹 and the whole thing is leaving fans both excited 😍 and a bit sore 😣 from the wallet spanking 💸 yet they still line up like thirsty 🥵 devotees ready to get railed for that iconic Glastonbury experience 🌟!! The festival last ran in 2025 with Olivia Rodrigo 👩‍🎤 The 1975 🎸 and Neil Young 🧔 topping the bill so the 2027 edition is shaping up to be an absolute unit 💪 of a comeback after the fallow year 🌾 and rumours are swirling harder than ever with everyone from Fontaines DC 🥁 to Harry Styles 👨‍🎤 potentially headlining while Emily keeps her lips zipped 🤐 on the juicy details!!

Glastonbury 🏕️ said they would not be commenting on this announcement but the facts are crystal clear the tickets 🎟️ are going up the dates are locked in and the registration 📝 scramble is about to begin so if you want in you better have that valid number 🔢 ready before the clock strikes 🕒 and the virtual queue swallows you whole 🌊!! Fans are already refreshing their browsers like it's a thirst trap 📱 hoping to score that golden ticket 🎫 to the muddiest most expensive music weekend in the UK while the organisers balance the books 📒 against rising energy costs and labour shortages that keep pushing prices into record territory 🏆!! One cheeky bystander whispered "I registered months ago but seeing that £408 price made me fold 🙇 like a lawn chair still worth it though cause nothing rails 💦 quite like Glastonbury at full throttle" and with three mystery headliners still cooking 🍳 in the background this fallow year hangover is about to turn into the horniest most overpriced festival season yet!!
